risks.risk: Potential for username or email conflicts if existing data is migrated.
risks.mitigation: Ensure usernames and emails are unique before migration. Validate data integrity with pre-migration checks.

risks.risk: Password hashing implementation may fail if not properly tested.
risks.mitigation: Use a robust hashing library (e.g., bcrypt) and test thoroughly in staging environments.

risks.risk: Foreign key constraints may cause issues if referenced data is missing.
risks.mitigation: Ensure all referenced data exists before migration or handle missing data gracefully.
